title: object-uri spec: wording inconsistencies found building jmap-object-uri
description: Mark's call (jmap-chat-spec). 1) chat-federation-00 strip rule says 'JMAP object URI (scheme jmap)' but object-uri-00 reserves jmap:// forms that are not object URIs: say 'a jmap URI'. 2) chat-00 link span 'MUST NOT be a JMAP object URI' leaves jmap:// allowed. 3) chat-tasks-00 registers tasklist/task but no IETF doc registers Task/TaskList in the RFC 9404 Data Types registry, so they fail object-uri's expert check. 4) graph-projection-00 claims all RFC 8621/9610 types but omits VacationResponse. 5) type-name has no length limit (ids capped at 255).
close_reason: Spec patch committed as jmap-chat-spec 55246b1 (Mark approved); type-name 255 limit implemented in jmap-types with tests in jmap-object-uri
